.unban_ip — lift the ban on someone's address (staff)

  .unban_ip <name>

The mirror of .ban_ip: you name the person you banned, and the house
finds the same address and lifts it. As everywhere, you never see the
address and never have to type one.

For an account ban, .unban <name>. Two bans, two commands, because
banning a person and banning an address are two different things.

Lifting does not erase the history — the house still knows the address
was banned once, which is what lets it warn whoever bans next.
